content.text:
The page matches the approved screenshots again. Both the desktop and phone visual tests pass.

Two values in `site/css/styles.css` had been changed from Bootstrap's defaults:
- **`.small` font size (line 223):** `0.438em` was shrinking the "SKU: BST-498" text to almost nothing. I set it back to `.875em`, which also shifted the text below it.
- **Dropdown caret margin (line 3205):** `0.383em` put the caret next to "Shop" a couple of pixels too far right. I set it back to `0.255em`.

I haven't committed anything.

STATUS: DONE
